IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_HideMod_Tooltip: Removes the panel and the XP icon from the game.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_AutoHide_Tooltip: The panel stays hidden and appears only when you earn XP in a skill you follow, then hides again.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ResetPos_Tooltip: Restores the default position and size of the panel.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_BarStart_Tooltip: Bar colour at the start of a level.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_BarEnd_Tooltip: Bar colour when the level is nearly complete.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_TextColor_Tooltip: Applies to the skill name, the level and the XP numbers.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_Stack_Tooltip: When several skills gain XP at once, up to three panels appear, one below the other.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_OverPlayer_Tooltip: The numbers rise over your character instead of over the panel. They still appear while the panel is folded away.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_ReplaceVanillaXp_Tooltip: Turns off the game crafting XP texts and replaces every radio and TV notice with ours: Neat arrow and lettering above your head, with the skill icon when it is a skill.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_StackAbove_Tooltip: The extra panels appear above the main one instead of below. Use it when you keep the panel low on the screen.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropDown_Tooltip: The numbers fall below the panel instead of rising above it. Use it when you keep the panel against the top edge.
IGUI_NeatXP_Opt_DropSize_Tooltip: How big the XP numbers are, over the panel or over your character.
